s0201.literal: Newly submitted households of Yunnan were registered.
s0201.idiomatic: Newly submitted households in Yunnan were registered.

s0202.literal: Since Uriangqadai garrisoned Yunnan, household rolls had been taken eight times and land rolls four times; the people regarded this as a hardship.
s0202.idiomatic: Since Uriangqadai garrisoned Yunnan, household rolls had been taken eight times and land rolls four times, and the people found it oppressive.

s0203.literal: At this time it was ordered that those already registered not be disturbed and only the newly submitted be registered.
s0203.idiomatic: At this time it was ordered that those already registered be left alone and only the newly submitted registered.

s0204.literal: Yunnan taxes and levies were fixed with gold as the standard, payable in cowrie shells at twenty strings per mace of gold.
s0204.idiomatic: Yunnan taxes and levies were fixed with gold as the standard, payable in cowrie shells at twenty strings per mace of gold.

s0205.literal: The Yunnan pacification commission was abolished.
s0205.idiomatic: The Yunnan pacification commission was abolished.

s0206.literal: On renshen day an edict ordered Pingluan, Goryeo, Tamna, Yangzhou, Longxing, and Quanzhou jointly to build three thousand large and small ships.
s0206.idiomatic: On renshen day an edict ordered Pingluan, Goryeo, Tamna, Yangzhou, Longxing, and Quanzhou jointly to build three thousand large and small ships.

s0207.literal: North of Yixi Busi, Xiang Shixiong and his brothers of Man Cave and the various caves of Sanmao rebelled; the Sichuan Branch Secretariat was ordered to dispatch Yixi Busi troops to pacify them and have them come together with their lord.
s0207.idiomatic: North of Yixi Busi, Xiang Shixiong and his brothers of Man Cave and the various Sanmao caves rebelled; the Sichuan branch secretariat was ordered to send Yixi Busi troops to pacify them and bring them in with their lord.

s0208.literal: On guiyou day Ahmad's nephew Zainuding was executed.
s0208.idiomatic: On guiyou day Ahmad's nephew Zainuding was executed.

s0209.literal: Ma Lin of Husin's faction was dismissed as left associate of the Jianghuai Branch Secretariat.
s0209.idiomatic: Ma Lin of Husin's faction was dismissed as left associate of the Jianghuai branch secretariat.

s0210.literal: On dinghai day envoys were dispatched to register gold produced in Yunnan; Boluo was made darughachi of the gold-mining district.
s0210.idiomatic: On dinghai day envoys were sent to register gold produced in Yunnan; Boluo was made darughachi of the gold-mining district.

s0211.literal: On wuyin day clothing and grain were issued to the newly submitted soldier Jia You.
s0211.idiomatic: On wuyin day clothing and grain were issued to the newly submitted soldier Jia You.

s0212.literal: You said he was the son-in-law of Marshal Jiao of Japan, knew about shipbuilding in Jiangnan, and had been sent to observe conditions; with the army pressing the border, he wished to submit first.
s0212.idiomatic: You said he was the son-in-law of Marshal Jiao of Japan, knew Jiangnan shipbuilding, and had been sent to watch developments; with the army at the border, he wished to submit first.

s0213.literal: On xinsi day an edict ordered each branch secretariat to use only one seal and confiscate the rest, and also confiscated seals held under the various princes.
s0213.idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict ordered each branch secretariat to use only one seal and confiscate the rest, and also confiscated seals held by the various princes.

s0214.literal: Thirty thousand ingots of notes were issued to purchase harmoniously ninety thousand shi of grain at Longxing, Dexing Prefecture, and Xuande.
s0214.idiomatic: Thirty thousand ingots of notes were issued to purchase ninety thousand shi of grain at Longxing, Dexing Prefecture, and Xuande.

s0215.literal: On renshen day Prince Azhiji was granted five thousand liang of gold and fifty thousand liang of silver.
s0215.idiomatic: On renshen day Prince Azhiji was granted five thousand liang of gold and fifty thousand liang of silver.

s0216.literal: Selection law was corrected; a black register was established to list the names of Ahmad's faction;
s0216.idiomatic: Selection law was corrected; a black register was established to list members of Ahmad's faction;

s0217.literal: each route was ordered to submit one Confucian scholar and one clerk annually, and each circuit surveillance commission was to recommend the incorruptible and capable for promotion and transfer.
s0217.idiomatic: each route was ordered to submit one Confucian scholar and one clerk annually, and each circuit surveillance commission was to recommend the incorruptible and capable for promotion and transfer.

s0218.literal: Winter, tenth month, dinghai new moon: Zhejiang salt prices were raised.
s0218.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the dinghai new moon, Zhejiang salt prices were raised.

s0219.literal: An edict ordered paper currency rectified.
s0219.idiomatic: An edict ordered paper currency rectified.

s0220.literal: On jichou day an edict ordered Buddhist monks, Daoists, and Nestorian Christians in Hexi who had wives to pay taxes like commoners.
s0220.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict ordered Buddhist monks, Daoists, and Nestorian Christians in Hexi who had wives to pay taxes like commoners.

s0221.literal: On gengyin day, because the harvest failed, all armies were permitted to hunt south of Bianliang.
s0221.idiomatic: On gengyin day, because the harvest failed, all armies were permitted to hunt south of Bianliang.

s0222.literal: On xinmao day Yelü Zhu, co-administrator of state affairs and overseer of the dynastic history, was made left grand councillor of the Central Secretariat.
s0222.idiomatic: On xinmao day Yelü Zhu, co-administrator of state affairs and overseer of the dynastic history, was made left grand councillor of the Central Secretariat.

s0223.literal: On renchen day sacrifice was offered at the imperial ancestral temple.
s0223.idiomatic: On renchen day sacrifice was offered at the imperial ancestral temple.

s0224.literal: The Xijing pacification commission was abolished.
s0224.idiomatic: The Xijing pacification commission was abolished.

s0225.literal: On bingshen day the Court of the Heir Apparent was first established; Wanze was made right court administrator and Saiyang left court administrator.
s0225.idiomatic: On bingshen day the court of the heir apparent was first established; Wanze was made right court administrator and Saiyang left court administrator.

s0226.literal: From Dadu to Central Luan, and from Central Luan to Guazhou, north and south grain transport commissions were established.
s0226.idiomatic: From Dadu to Central Luan, and from Central Luan to Guazhou, north and south grain transport commissions were established.

s0227.literal: Five salt transport offices were established: the Lutai Yuezhi Sangcha Salt Transport Office, Hejian Cangqing, Shandong Bin, Lean, and Jiaolai, Ju, and Mi.
s0227.idiomatic: Five salt transport offices were established: Lutai Yuezhi Sangcha, Hejian Cangqing, Shandong Bin, Lean, and Jiaolai, Ju, and Mi.

s0228.literal: An edict ordered that fine confiscated goods and gold, silver, and silks enter the inner treasury, the rest handed to the Ministry of Justice for later distribution.
s0228.idiomatic: An edict ordered fine confiscated goods and gold, silver, and silks into the inner treasury, with the rest handed to the Ministry of Justice for later distribution.

s0229.literal: Palace receipts and disbursements were divided among three treasuries: imperial jade and rare objects from distant lands under the inner storehouse, gold and silver and jisun silks under the right storehouse, and regular tribute silks, gauze, and cloth under the left storehouse.
s0229.idiomatic: Palace receipts and disbursements were divided among three treasuries: imperial jade and rare objects from distant lands in the inner storehouse, gold and silver and jisun silks in the right storehouse, and regular tribute silks, gauze, and cloth in the left storehouse.

s0230.literal: Thirty-two officials with keys were established, with twenty-two eunuchs supervising the matter.
s0230.idiomatic: Thirty-two key-holding officials were appointed, with twenty-two eunuchs supervising them.

s0231.literal: Grand Court office officials were reduced.
s0231.idiomatic: Grand Court office officials were reduced.

s0232.literal: On guimao day Cui Yu and others were ordered to audit Military Affairs Bureau documents.
s0232.idiomatic: On guimao day Cui Yu and others were ordered to audit Military Affairs Bureau documents.

s0233.literal: On jiachen day the Champa envoys who had submitted returned; clothes were granted them.
s0233.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Champa envoys who had submitted returned; clothes were granted them.

s0234.literal: On yisi day Ada was dispatched to induce Farlang, Aru, Ganbo, and other countries to submit.
s0234.idiomatic: On yisi day Ada was dispatched to induce Farlang, Aru, Ganbo, and other countries to submit.

s0235.literal: The garrison-farming commissionerate was abolished; its affairs were placed under the Military Affairs Bureau, and military wanhu were ordered to hold the posts concurrently.
s0235.idiomatic: The garrison-farming commissionerate was abolished; its affairs were placed under the Military Affairs Bureau, and military wanhu were ordered to hold the posts concurrently.

s0236.literal: On bingwu day Wang Weixiao was made commander-in-chief.
s0236.idiomatic: On bingwu day Wang Weixiao was made commander-in-chief.

s0237.literal: On dingwei day the Jurchen Liushi volunteered to build ships and transport grain to Ghost Country to supply the army; this was approved.
s0237.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Jurchen Liushi volunteered to build ships and transport grain to Ghost Country to supply the army; the request was approved.

s0238.literal: Campaigning against Chaba Cave was discussed.
s0238.idiomatic: Campaigning against Chaba Cave was discussed.

s0239.literal: On gengxu day, because Sichuan had only one hundred twenty thousand households but more than two hundred fifty government offices, the Sichuan Branch Secretariat was ordered to discuss reducing them.
s0239.idiomatic: On gengxu day, because Sichuan had only 120,000 households but more than 250 government offices, the Sichuan branch secretariat was ordered to discuss reducing them.

s0240.literal: The Chengdu pacification commission was moved to Diaomen, and the Lizhou and Shunqing Prefecture pacification commissions were abolished.
s0240.idiomatic: The Chengdu pacification commission was moved to Diaomen, and the Lizhou and Shunqing prefecture pacification commissions were abolished.

s0241.literal: Wine was forbidden in Dadu and Shanbei prefectures.
s0241.idiomatic: Wine was forbidden in Dadu and Shanbei prefectures.

s0242.literal: An edict ordered that officials below rank five in Guangdong, Guangxi, and Fujian be appointed conveniently by the branch secretariat.
s0242.idiomatic: An edict ordered officials below rank five in Guangdong, Guangxi, and Fujian appointed at the branch secretariat's discretion.

s0243.literal: Yelü Zhu said: "Officials gathering palace women seize the occasion to harm the people; if large prefectures take three per year and small prefectures two, choosing those suitable, generously compensating their parents, and otherwise sending them back, that would be appropriate.
s0243.idiomatic: Yelü Zhu said, "Officials gathering palace women seize the occasion to harm the people; if large prefectures take three per year and small prefectures two, choosing those suitable, generously compensating their parents, and otherwise sending them back, that would be appropriate.

s0245.literal: Concealed farmland in the capital region was registered, and tax was collected by measured acreage.
s0245.idiomatic: Concealed farmland in the capital region was registered and taxed by measured acreage.

s0246.literal: You Xian was ordered solely in charge of Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat grain transport.
s0246.idiomatic: You Xian was placed solely in charge of Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grain transport.

s0247.literal: On yimao day Jiantong was ordered solely in charge of memorials.
s0247.idiomatic: On yimao day Jiantong was placed solely in charge of memorials.

s0248.literal: Ahmad's eldest son Husin and second son Masuhu were executed at Yangzhou, both pickled.
s0248.idiomatic: Ahmad's eldest son Husin and second son Masuhu were executed at Yangzhou and their bodies pickled.

s0249.literal: Eleventh month, wu day: a Utilization Treasury was built at Shangdu.
s0249.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wu day, a utilization treasury was built at Shangdu.

s0250.literal: One thousand two hundred ingots were granted to two hundred sixty households of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, ceremonial music, sacred field cultivation, and the like.
s0250.idiomatic: 1,200 ingots were granted to 260 households of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, ceremonial music, sacred field cultivation, and the like.

s0251.literal: On jiazi day clothing was issued to Qianzhou garrison-farming troops.
s0251.idiomatic: On jiazi day clothing was issued to Qianzhou garrison-farming troops.

s0252.literal: On dingmao day silver notes and silks were issued to officers returning from the Karakorum garrison.
s0252.idiomatic: On dingmao day silver notes and silks were issued to officers returning from the Karakorum garrison.

s0253.literal: Kong Shu, hereditary Duke of Confucius from Jiangnan, came to audience; he was made chancellor of the National University, concurrently overseeing Zhedong schools, and salary and a seal to maintain the forest temple were granted on the spot.
s0253.idiomatic: Kong Shu, hereditary Duke of Confucius from Jiangnan, came to audience; he was made chancellor of the National University and concurrently overseer of Zhedong schools, with salary and a seal to maintain the forest temple granted on the spot.

s0254.literal: An edict proclaimed Ahmad's crimes at home and abroad; whatever harmed or benefited the people was to be remedied or instituted.
s0254.idiomatic: An edict proclaimed Ahmad's crimes at home and abroad; whatever harmed or benefited the people was to be remedied or instituted.

s0255.literal: On renshen day, because powerful families acting as merchants blocked official and private vessels, river patrol troops were established along the waterways; violators' families were forfeited.
s0255.idiomatic: On renshen day, because powerful families acting as merchants blocked official and private vessels, river patrol troops were established along the waterways; violators' families were forfeited.

s0256.literal: On guiyou day part of Marshal Qi Gongzhi's army was garrisoned at Quxian.
s0256.idiomatic: On guiyou day part of Marshal Qi Gongzhi's army was garrisoned at Quxian.

s0257.literal: On jiaxu day Central Secretariat officials said: "Among serious criminals empire-wide, apart from treason, great sedition, killing grandparents or parents, wives killing husbands, slaves killing masters, and killing husbands through adultery—all punished by proper statute—those who committed other capital crimes are to serve as soldiers in Japan, Champa, and Burma.
s0257.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Central Secretariat officials said, "Among serious criminals empire-wide, apart from treason, great sedition, killing grandparents or parents, wives killing husbands, slaves killing masters, and killing husbands through adultery—all punished by proper statute—those who committed other capital crimes are to serve as soldiers in Japan, Champa, and Burma.

s0260.literal: On bingzi day the Sichuan Branch Secretariat induced the chiefs of Dapan Cave, including Xiang Chouyou, to come to court.
s0260.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Sichuan branch secretariat induced the chiefs of Dapan Cave, including Xiang Chouyou, to come to court.

s0261.literal: On wuyin day Yelü Zhu said: "Earlier an edict ordered that murderers be put to death and still pay fifty liang of burning-burial silver; later only two ingots of notes were collected—the penalty is too light.
s0261.idiomatic: On wuyin day Yelü Zhu said, "Earlier an edict ordered murderers put to death and still pay fifty liang of burning-burial silver; later only two ingots of notes were collected—the penalty is too light.

s0262.literal: We propose that, following Mongol custom, the offender forfeit a daughter to the victim's family, and if there is no daughter, four ingots of notes be collected.
s0262.idiomatic: We propose that, following Mongol custom, the offender forfeit a daughter to the victim's family, and if there is no daughter, four ingots of notes be collected.

s0264.literal: Yuan Prefecture, Rao Prefecture, and Xingguo Army were again placed under Longxing Province.
s0264.idiomatic: Yuan Prefecture, Rao Prefecture, and Xingguo Army were again placed under Longxing Province.

s0265.literal: Ma'bar dispatched envoys with a gold-leaf letter and local products as tribute.
s0265.idiomatic: Ma'bar sent envoys with a gold-leaf letter and local products as tribute.

s0266.literal: Chief Merit Commissioner Tuolie was dismissed; Buddhist rites he had arranged at government expense were all recovered.
s0266.idiomatic: Chief merit commissioner Tuolie was dismissed; Buddhist rites he had arranged at government expense were all recovered.

s0267.literal: Notes for sheep and horses were granted to the poor among Henanar, Bazi, and others.
s0267.idiomatic: Notes for sheep and horses were granted to the poor among Henanar, Bazi, and others.

s0268.literal: Twelfth month, dinghai day: Alahai was ordered to take charge of three hundred sea ships belonging to Fan Wenhu and others.
s0268.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dinghai day, Alahai was ordered to take charge of three hundred sea ships belonging to Fan Wenhu and others.

s0269.literal: On renyin day Zhang Wenqian, left associate of the Central Secretariat, was made deputy commissioner of the Military Affairs Bureau.
s0269.idiomatic: On renyin day Zhang Wenqian, left associate of the Central Secretariat, was made deputy commissioner of the Military Affairs Bureau.

s0270.literal: On yiwei day Central Secretariat officials said: "Duke of Pingyuan Zhao Yourui, Duke of Ying Zhao Qi, and Hanlin direct academician Zhao Yubiao should all reside at Shangdu.
s0270.idiomatic: On yiwei day Central Secretariat officials said, "Duke of Pingyuan Zhao Yourui, Duke of Ying Zhao Qi, and Hanlin direct academician Zhao Yubiao should all reside at Shangdu.

s0271.literal: " The Emperor said: "Yourui is old; he should remain in Dadu; the rest as proposed.
s0271.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Yourui is old; he should remain in Dadu; the rest as proposed.

s0272.literal: " An edict then ordered supplies given and Zhao Qi sent off; only Zhao Yubiao was not to go.
s0272.idiomatic: " An edict then ordered supplies given and Zhao Qi sent off; only Zhao Yubiao was not to go.

s0273.literal: Because Zhongshan Xue Baozhu submitted an anonymous letter denouncing treason, Song chancellor Wen Tianxiang was executed.
s0273.idiomatic: Because Zhongshan Xue Baozhu submitted an anonymous letter denouncing treason, Song chancellor Wen Tianxiang was executed.

s0274.literal: On guimao day censor-in-chief Cui Yu said: "Censorial officials, regarding the gains and losses of state affairs, the welfare and hardship of the people, and the upright and corrupt among officials—even princes, dukes, generals, and ministers—should all impeach and investigate.
s0274.idiomatic: On guimao day censor-in-chief Cui Yu said, "Censorial officials, regarding the gains and losses of state affairs, the welfare and hardship of the people, and the upright and corrupt among officials—even princes, dukes, generals, and ministers—should all impeach and investigate.

s0275.literal: Recently only censors have spoken; I hold that all censorial officials should offer advice, so that the state may benefit.
s0275.idiomatic: Recently only censors have spoken; I hold that all censorial officials should offer advice, so that the state may benefit.

s0276.literal: In selecting censorial officials, if done by the Central Secretariat there will surely be partiality.
s0276.idiomatic: In selecting censorial officials, if done by the Central Secretariat there will surely be partiality.

s0277.literal: Censors should be chosen from this bureau itself; initially sixteen Han officials were used, but now sixteen Mongols are used—mixing them in circuit tours would be appropriate.
s0277.idiomatic: Censors should be chosen from the censorate itself; initially sixteen Han officials were used, but now sixteen Mongols are used—mixing them on circuit tours would be appropriate.

s0280.literal: The Guard of the Heir Apparent was reduced back to rank four, and its tiger tally was again collected.
s0280.idiomatic: The guard of the heir apparent was reduced back to rank four, and its tiger tally was again collected.

s0281.literal: The Hubei-Guangdong Branch Secretariat gold, silver, and iron smelting bureau was abolished; its affairs were placed under the various route chief offices.
s0281.idiomatic: The Hubei-Guangdong branch secretariat gold, silver, and iron smelting bureau was abolished; its affairs were placed under the various route chief offices.

s0282.literal: The Jiankang gold-washing commissionerate was placed under Jiankang Route.
s0282.idiomatic: The Jiankang gold-washing commissionerate was placed under Jiankang Route.

s0283.literal: Right associate of the Central Secretariat Zhachan was made co-administrator.
s0283.idiomatic: Right associate of the Central Secretariat Zhachan was made co-administrator.

s0284.literal: The Jie salt office and the various salt offices were abolished; transport officials were ordered to dispatch salt certificates in person.
s0284.idiomatic: The Jie salt office and the various salt offices were abolished; transport officials were ordered to dispatch salt certificates in person.

s0285.literal: The Nanjing garrison-farming commissionerate was abolished; its affairs were placed under Nanyang Prefecture.
s0285.idiomatic: The Nanjing garrison-farming commissionerate was abolished; its affairs were placed under Nanyang Prefecture.

s0286.literal: Ali Haiya restored the Zhenyuan Army; one thousand troops were dispatched to garrison it, and because the place adjoined the West Sichuan Branch Secretariat it was placed under it.
s0286.idiomatic: Ali Haiya restored the Zhenyuan Army; one thousand troops were dispatched to garrison it, and because the place adjoined the West Sichuan branch secretariat it was placed under it.

s0287.literal: An edict established Imperial Preceptor Dharmapala Raktajita, holding the jade seal and overseeing Buddhist clergy of all countries.
s0287.idiomatic: An edict established Imperial Preceptor Dharmapala Raktajita, holding the jade seal and overseeing Buddhist clergy of all countries.

s0288.literal: A stupa for Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa was built.
s0288.idiomatic: A stupa for Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa was built.

s0289.literal: Accumulated land rent, tax, and levies owed in Gongchang and other places were remitted.
s0289.idiomatic: Accumulated land rent, tax, and levies owed in Gongchang and other places were remitted.

s0290.literal: Horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in graded amounts to Tachar and others under Prince North An.
s0290.idiomatic: Horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in graded amounts to Tachar and others under Prince North An.

s0291.literal: In the twentieth year, spring, first month, on the bingchen new moon, King Wang Chun of Goryeo dispatched his grand general Yu Hongshen to offer congratulations.
s0291.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, on the bingchen new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent his grand general Yu Hongshen to offer congratulations.

s0292.literal: On jiwei day the empress of the Hongjira clan was installed.
s0292.idiomatic: On jiwei day the empress of the Hongjira clan was installed.

s0293.literal: On xinyou day a seal was granted to Prince Chubo, and army notes were granted as rewards to Prince Bichitemür and consort Changji.
s0293.idiomatic: On xinyou day a seal was granted to Prince Chubo, and army notes were granted as rewards to Prince Bichitemür and consort Changji.

s0294.literal: An edict ordered that princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law who held Jiangnan appanages pay one hundred ingots from the rent of ten thousand households, equivalent to the Central Plains five-households silk quota.
s0294.idiomatic: An edict ordered princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law who held Jiangnan appanages to pay one hundred ingots from the rent of ten thousand households, equivalent to the Central Plains five-households silk quota.

s0295.literal: On guihai day Yao Lahai was ordered to lead an army against Burma.
s0295.idiomatic: On guihai day Yao Lahai was ordered to lead an army against Burma.

s0296.literal: On yichou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo dispatched the envoy Wuladai to present four hundred bolts of felt cloth, thread silk, and the like as tribute.
s0296.idiomatic: On yichou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent the envoy Wuladai to present four hundred bolts of felt cloth, thread silk, and the like as tribute.

s0297.literal: Helü Huosun said: "Last winter the villain Xue Baozhu of Zhongshan Prefecture submitted an anonymous letter, foolishly imitating Dongfang Shuo's style, deceiving the court and hoping for an official reward.
s0297.idiomatic: Helü Huosun said, "Last winter the villain Xue Baozhu of Zhongshan Prefecture submitted an anonymous letter, foolishly imitating Dongfang Shuo's style, deceiving the court and hoping for an official reward.

s0299.literal: He also said: "From now on, anyone who wishes to lodge a complaint must write his real name and the facts of the case and present the petition at the secretariat or censorate.
s0299.idiomatic: He also said, "From now on, anyone who wishes to lodge a complaint must write his real name and the facts of the case and present the petition at the secretariat or censorate.

s0300.literal: Whoever dares report by anonymous letter—severely punished with death, lightly punished with exile to a distant place;
s0300.idiomatic: Whoever dares report by anonymous letter—severely punished with death, lightly punished with exile to a distant place;
